text:
Anita: Heads up — Valen Health hitting integration blockers during private deploy. Customer's SI (BrightLane) says model container keeps OOMing when sequence_len ~ 4096, and PKI handshake failing with our marketplace image signature check. Need architecture review + field escalation.

Sam: Thanks. Can you paste logs? also what's the infra shape (GPUs, nodes)?

Anita: pasted logs:
```
2026-03-18T17:22:11Z stderr: runtime: out of memory allocating 134217728
model: redwood-open-7b-q4_0
node: g4dn.12xlarge (4 x A100?), 1 x 80GB
```
Also getting cert validation errors: "signature verification failed: key not found"

Diego: on it. Quick q: Did SI use our signed marketplace image or a custom build?

Anita: BrightLane pulled marketplace image v2026-02-18 and then applied internal patch. We suspect the patch removed the signature metadata during repackaging.

Riley: From arch side — if they've repackaged, KV cache format must match runtime. Can we get their container diff? Also need output of `rdw-inspect --model redwood-open-7b-q4_0 --cpu-readout` (ask SI)

Sam: I'll schedule a quick architecture call. Available 30m. @Diego @Riley can you join? Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/arch-valen-quick

Diego: joining. Meanwhile add temporary rollback: instruct SI to revert to marketplace image hash 0x9f3a... and run:
```
docker run --rm -e RDW_MODE=production redwood/serve:v2026-02-18 --model redwood-open-7b-q4_0 --max-seq 2048
```
Anita: Customer also reported a networking intermittency — initial TLS handshake times out from our telemetry: retry_count spikes. Could be MTU on their edge device.

Diego: Noted. Ask BrightLane to run:
```
# on gateway
ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000
curl -v https://private.redwood.valen/healthz -o /dev/null
```

Sam: If MTU not the issue, we can route through dedicated peering and bypass their firewall for a quick test. That requires marketplace entitlement change (ticket to marketplace team). @deploy-bot can you create a ticket?

deploy-bot: Created ticket MKT-7621 "Valen Health SI debug route / entitlement" assigned to marketplace-oncall. https://issues.redwood.ai/MKT-7621

Riley: Also flagging compliance: Valen needs HIPAA attestation for Private deploy. SI must sign BAAs before we move to dedicated peering. Put it in the runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/si/runbooks/hipaa-checklist

Anita: Thanks all. Action items for BrightLane: 1) revert to marketplace hash 0x9f3a..., 2) provide `rdw-inspect` output + container diff, 3) run MTU test. We'll meet in 30m. If OOM persists, we'll temporarily lower max_seq and enable KV prefix caching.

Diego: ack. I'll standby and prepare a canary rollback plan with exact commands.

Sam: I'll update the SI delivery ticket with steps and timeline. ETA follow-up in this thread after call. :thumbsup:

Anita: Meeting notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/notes/valen-field-engage-1769004321
